title: Line 96: broad `except Exception` (BLE001)
detail: Catching `Exception` at line 96 prevents distinguishing expected errors from unexpected failures. Fix: catch specific exception types, or re-raise after logging if a broad catch is intentional.

title: Line 89: inconsistent return statements — some paths return a value, some don't
detail: The function at/near line 89 has paths that return a value and paths that fall off the end (implicit `return None`). Callers expecting a return value silently receive `None` on the implicit path. Fix: add explicit `return None` or ensure all paths return a consistent type.
